name: Risetto Valentine
original_name: リゼット＝ヴァレンタイン
source:
An extraordinary magician with a harsh personality, she's not the type to get along well with others.Likes to blast with magic first, and ask questions later. However, she opens up to her childhoods friends, sisters [url=/c90422]Rena[/url] and [url=/c90424]Leticia[/url]. Rena adventures together with her, but Rizette is shy about calling her a partner. Leticia looks up to her more than her own sister.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE290683.html]DLsite English[/url]]
